sourceTitle: No-Bake Peanut Butter Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
sourceText:
No-Bake Peanut Butter Chocolate Oatmeal Cookies
By: Alison Cunha
Published: Monday, December 21, 2009 - 10:54am

Ingredients




2 cups of white sugar
1 stick of butter
1/2 cup a  of natural peanut butter
1/4 cup of a  of cocoa
1/2 cup a  of milk
3 cops of oats

Preparation

1 Put 2 cups of white sugar, 1 stick of butter (YES REAL BUTTER..gasp!),A cup of natural peanut butter, 1/4 of a cup of cocoa, and 1/2 a cup of milk in a medium sauce pan and bring it to a boil. 2 Add 3 cups of oats 3 Spoon teaspoon sized chucks out onto wax paper and let cool. 4 ENJOY!

About


Super easy and tasty!!!!
